title: Avoiding What Your Teacher Already Knows: Entity Familiarity for Deep-Search Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16251v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep-search agents are commonly trained by distilling tool-use trajectories from stronger teacher models. However, structurally complex questions may remain relatively easy for teachers familiar with key entities in the underlying entity graph, resulting in lower search demand and weaker supervision. We refer to this teacher-specific variation in question difficulty as teacher-relative difficulty and investigate entity familiarity as an early predictor. We first introduce Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity (EVF), which estimates familiarity by verifying a teacher-generated factual brief against online evidence. Across multiple teachers, EVF is significantly correlated with teacher-relative difficulty with AUCs of 0.60--0.70. However, its high cost makes it impractical for constructing entity graphs at scale. translated_title: 避开你的老师已经知道的内容：用于深度搜索蒸馏的实体熟悉度
translated_abstract: 深度搜索智能体通常通过从更强的教师模型蒸馏工具使用轨迹来进行训练。然而，对于熟悉底层实体图中关键实体的教师而言，结构上复杂的问题可能仍然相对容易，从而导致搜索需求降低和监督信号减弱。我们将这种因教师而异的问题难度变化称为教师相对难度，并将实体熟悉度作为一种早期预测指标加以研究。我们首先引入了证据验证实体熟悉度（EVF），它通过将教师生成的事实简报与在线证据进行核对来估计熟悉度。在多个教师模型上，EVF与教师相对难度显著相关，AUC达到0.60—0.70。然而，其高昂的成本使其难以用于大规模构建实体图。为解决这一局限，我们提出了自报告实体熟悉度（SEF），这是一种轻量级的门控信号，直接询问（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用证据验证实体熟悉度（EVF）和轻量级的自报告实体熟悉度（SEF）作为教师相对难度的早期预测信号，从而在深度搜索蒸馏中筛选出教师真正需要搜索才能回答的高价值训练问题，提升蒸馏监督质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity (EVF) and a lightweight Self-Reported Entity Familiarity (SEF) as early predictors of teacher-relative difficulty, enabling deep-search distillation to filter for questions where teachers genuinely need to search and thereby improving supervision quality.
